name: theme-feature-wall
description: v0.31.8.2 visual verification: Coastal and Tropical Biophilic move their theme colour off every dry wall and onto ONE fluted feature wall, per the grounding research. Japandi is the CONTROL — it already shipped a feature wall at the same position against the same default layout, so if its panel reads correctly and the two new ones do not, the fault is the content and not the position.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: assert-coastal-feature-wall-placed
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const fw=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='coastal-feature'); if(!fw) throw new Error('coastal-feature was not placed. feature-wall items: '+JSON.stringify(s.items.filter(i=>i.defId==='feature-wall').map(i=>i.id))); if(fw.props.color!=='#a9c1d6') throw new Error('unexpected feature colour '+fw.props.color); const walls=s.finishes&&s.finishes.walls; window.__probe=JSON.stringify({feature:fw.props, wallFinishes:walls}); })()

steps.name: assert-tropical-feature-wall-placed
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const fw=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='cozy-feature'); if(!fw) throw new Error('cozy-feature was not placed. feature-wall items: '+JSON.stringify(s.items.filter(i=>i.defId==='feature-wall').map(i=>i.id))); if(fw.props.color!=='#a7b59a') throw new Error('unexpected feature colour '+fw.props.color); })()
